text: Alla daalani Nuuhu (yo o his): Ko an yo Nuuhu, jippor e laana kan ka leydi wonndude e kisal e hoolaare, e neemaaji ɗuuɗuɗi hoore-maaɗa immorde ka Alla -e hoore jurriiyaaji ɓen gomɗimɓe wonndunooɓe e maaɗa ka laana aroyooɓe ɓaawo maaɗa. Mofte goo e ɓiɗɓe maɓɓe yedduɓe ɓen, aray Men dakmita ɓe e ɗam nguurndam aduna, Men newinana ɓe ko ɓe wuurira; refti memoya ɓe ka laakara immorde e Amen, lepte muusuɗe.
